one_flow_among: Placing an order is one of the things eShop does. It also lets a customer browse and search the catalogue, fill a basket (with or without its AI shopping assistant), sign up and sign in, and lets an administrator ship an order. Building the basket comes before this flow and is set aside as a separate flow: the assistant can fill the basket but cannot place an order (ChatState.cs:41-47). This page says nothing about those flows.
what_it_is: Microsoft's reference online shop on .NET Aspire. A signed-in customer checks out a basket; the order is recorded as Submitted, waits out a one-minute grace period, has its stock checked by the catalogue, is paid by a simulated payment processor, and is then shipped when an administrator says so. The services talk over HTTP, gRPC and a RabbitMQ event bus.
modelled_from: Stages and steps drafted from reference models (APQC PCF, SCOR; checkout, order-management, payment and warehouse practice) without reading the code, then reconciled against what eShop at b4a4087 carries, read by the design-for-operations fact extractor and by hand. The stages and steps are the reference models'; what carries each step is the code's. Seven drafted steps have nothing found carrying them and are drawn as not assessed. Three steps are in the code only. Every measure's question is proposed; 12 of 20 measures cite a line the code already writes
expectation_of: the customer placing the order, who is sent to their orders page (Checkout.razor:115)
case: one order: one row in ordering.orders, created as Submitted (Order.cs:57; OrderRepository.cs:17)
starts_at: the customer begins checkout with a non-empty basket on /checkout (Checkout.razor:1, 6)
ends_at: proposed: the order is delivered to the customer; the code's last state is Shipped (OrderStatus.cs:12), set by an administrator, and nothing records delivery
case_identifier: no one field spans the flow. The request id (x-requestid, Checkout.razor:94) ends at ordering's idempotency table (RequestManager.cs:29); the order id is minted by the database on save (OrderEntityTypeConfiguration.cs:12) and carried by every event from GracePeriodConfirmed on; the first event, OrderStarted, carries only the user id (OrderStartedIntegrationEvent.cs:8)
promise: none stated; proposed: the order is delivered by the date promised at checkout (SCOR Perfect Order Fulfillment)
capability: C1 - every stage of the flow realizes C1
sources_examined: dotnet/eShop at b4a4087: the fact extractor's output over the AppHost-deployed services (its routes, calls and service map); greps for log lines; a keyword sweep over all of src/, including the mobile clients and WebhookClient the service map left out; and reading the files cited.
